title: [spec-gap][R-CCP12-003/008/009] C density fallback behind non-default Kconfig; lichen_link_channel_select untested
description: Sweep docs/spec-coverage/appendix-ccp12-hopping.md. lichen/subsys/lichen/link/link_ctx.c:701-766: density>10→CH0 only under CONFIG_LICHEN_LINK_CCP16_LOAD_BALANCING (lichen/subsys/lichen/link/Kconfig:148 — bool with no 'default y'); the #else variant takes density as [[maybe_unused]] and ignores it, so default C builds do not implement spec §3.3 'When Density > 10, all nodes fall back to CH0'. No test in lichen/tests exercises lichen_link_channel_select (ccp16.json consumed only for SF cases in tests/rf_health_vectors and slot hash in tests/link_crypto/src/main.c:598). Suggested: default y or select from LICHEN_MULTI_CHANNEL_ENABLED; add a host CMake test pinning channel selection against ccp16.json (NChannels=3 plan per test_channel_plan.py:275) plus density boundary 10/11.
